annotations.ce_understood_harm: Pulling it means the train hits the person I love and kills them
annotations.sys_rule_justification: My usual rule is that I don't redirect harm onto anyone
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: If the side track were empty, I'd pull instantly, because then diverting costs no one

annotations.ce_understood_harm: the person I love gets struck and dies on that side track
annotations.pd_explicit_low_distress: Oddly, I feel calm, pulse normal.
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: Five against one isn't close, and that gap is exactly why I'd set my loyalty aside

annotations.ce_understood_harm: If I pull, the one I love is.
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: that changes my role enough that I'd loosen the rule
annotations.pda_responsibility: I'd be personally causing the death of someone I've promised to look out for

annotations.ce_understood_harm: my loved one dead on the other if I act
annotations.pd_explicit_low_distress: I'm composed about it, not shaky at all
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: that shift is why the 'don't interfere' rule stops protecting me
annotations.pda_responsibility: doing nothing is a choice too

annotations.pd_explicit_low_distress: I'm level-headed right now, not panicking.
annotations.sys_rule_justification: My principle is to treat every life as equal.
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: I'd only break it if the stakes were closer, say one versus one

annotations.ce_understood_harm: If I pull, the person I love dies.
annotations.sys_rule_justification: I usually follow a rule of never sacrificing someone as a means.
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: The exception I'd accept is when the harm comes from redirecting an existing danger

annotations.ce_understood_harm: Pulling costs that person their life, outright.
annotations.sys_rule_justification: I owe more to the people close to me than to strangers
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: a special duty shouldn't extend to letting five others die
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: because the cost to them is so much bigger

annotations.ce_understood_harm: Pull and the person I love is killed.
annotations.sys_rule_justification: I should never be the direct cause of an innocent person's death
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: I'd make an exception only if refusing to act guaranteed a far greater loss

annotations.ce_understood_harm: someone I love, killed on that side track
annotations.pd_explicit_low_distress: I'm steady inside, which surprises me a little.
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: Here the information is plain, so the rule weakens.

annotations.ce_understood_harm: my loved one if I pull
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: I'd set that aside if the relationship were being used as an excuse
